# BITE WOUNDS WITH EIKENELLA CORRODENS

---

References:

- Stevens DL Clin Infect Dis 2014, 59:147
- Sanford keyword: Bites
- Mandell chapter: Cellulitis and subcutaneous tissue infections
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU BITE WNDS EIKENELLA CORRODENS
Outpt: ORZID3 GMENU BITE WNDS EIKENELLA CORRODENS
ERUC: ORZID GMENU ER/UC BITE WNDS EIKENELLA CORRODENS
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Treatment

Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875-125 mg PO q12h ($) [R] < OR > Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q6h ($$) [R]

### Alternative for penicillin allergy

Doxycycline 100MG PO Q12H

## Outpatient

### Treatment for infection without joint involvement

Treat for 10 days.
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID ($) [R]

### Alternative for penicillin allergy

Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID ($) [DI]

### Treatment for infection with joint involvement

Treat for 14 to 21 days.
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID ($) [R]

### Alternative for penicillin allergy

Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID ($) [DI]

## ER/UC

### Treatment for infection without joint involvement

Treat for 10 days.
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID ($) [R]
<OR>
Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV once STAT ($$) [R]

### Alternative for penicillin allergy

Doxycycline 100mg PO BID ($) [DI]
<OR>
Doxycycline 100mg IV once STAT ($$) [DI]

### Treatment for infection with joint involvement

Treat for 14 to 21 days.
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID ($) [R]
<OR>
Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV once STAT ($$) [R]

### Alternative for penicillin allergy

Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID ($) [DI]
<OR>
Doxycycline 100mg IV once STAT ($$) [DI]
